name: tool-auth-bridge
description: Mints Tool Room SSO custom tokens for the Firebase project it actually runs in — split out of metadata-sync-service because that service lives in a different GCP project (subverselab-project) and org policy blocks both cross-project service account attachment and service account key creation, so a custom token it signs is never trusted by this project's Identity Toolkit (CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH). This service runs natively in project-62238635-aae4-41f4-880 instead, so it signs as an identity that project actually trusts.
